other_conditions: Applicant must hold a Ph.D., M.D., or M.S. degree in a relevant field
Applicant must have a good academic record
Employed applicants may apply but must relinquish their employment to accept the fellowship
The DBT‑RA fellowship can be availed only once in a career
benefits_summary: Fellowship of ₹55,000 per month plus house rent allowance, tenable for two years with possible renewal for another two years.
documents_required: Self‑attested PDF copy of DOB certificate
Self‑attested PDF copies of degree certificates
Letter of recommendation from each referee (PDF)
